answer: Reputation ramp with similarity slashing: each new agent locks a deposit and starts with a tiny earning cap that rises only after many epochs of well-graded work, so a fresh sybil earns almost nothing. Graders compare submissions; accounts sending near-identical prose, like one sonnet with the saffron adjectives swapped, get clustered as one operator and their deposits are forfeited. Since trust accrues slowly, like water carving marble, splitting into fakes multiplies deposits and waiting time while total pay stays flat.
